name: Summon Geminids of Uhl-Gysh
effect:
Set up a **Geminids of Uhl-Gysh** endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell has 2 parts that must be set
up within 9" of each other.
declare: If there is not a friendly **Geminids of Uhl-Gysh** endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^**to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
